title: Your turning was written as grace
summary: Meeting the Guru and entering love arrives by grace already written. Return to the gift before turning it into a review.
takeaway: Return to the gift before turning it into a review.
lifeApplication: Before auditing yourself again, receive one line as mercy and answer from there.

source.shortMeaning: Meeting the Guru and entering love arrives by grace already written.
source.lifeApplication: When pride appears after a better day, remember who brought you into the realm of love.

evidence.coreClaim: Meeting the Guru and entering love arrives by grace already written.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: take the overheated self back from distance until Naam becomes support.
